issues.title: Retain full MAP01 occupancy posthoc analyzer-coverage failure
issues.body:
Tracks #428. Additive research only under `research/doom/map01_held_input_occupancy_full_posthoc_v1/**`; the temporary branch-only workflow was deleted before this PR and is absent from the final diff. No shared runtime/workflow/history mutation, no model/provider/GUI/XTEST/game execution, and no v38/v39 retained result rewrite.

## Source-first attempt
Publication base `9558313ed704804031733031f9e9443ddffc54de`; freeze head `51255221771f35652ffe1bbb68ed20a07f36b8c7`. Exact existing analyzer/test blobs and v38/v39 report/event SHA256s were frozen before computation. The existing analyzer regression suite passed 7/7.

## First outcome — retained failure
Decision: **`FAIL_INTEGRITY_ANALYZER_COVERAGE`**.

The first complete-log compute attempt (Actions run `35096754461`, job `104795892358`) stopped before aggregate output:
`AssertionError: started hold never reached keys_held: ('cover-4', 10)`.
No `result.json` was produced; no occupancy aggregate/ratio is claimed and the allocation is not rerun.

Read-only raw-trace inspection shows the failing state is a legitimate partial-admission cancellation, not missing bytes. v39 `cover-4` step10 starts a `Down+space` hold, admits/acks `Down`, receives cancel essentially concurrently, never admits `space`, never emits `keys_held`, and independently verifies empty owner input 13.209128 ms after the first admission attempt. Terminal is cancelled with steps_completed=10.

Therefore the prior analyzer invariant “every started hold reaches keys_held” is too strong for complete retained logs. The next task must separately preregister conservative zero/partial/full-admission interruption semantics rather than patching this result.

## Preserved harness defect
The one-off workflow piped Python through `tee` without `pipefail`, so GitHub displayed the compute/audit steps as successful despite Python tracebacks; the later hash step failed because `result.json` was absent and artifact upload was skipped. This supervision defect is retained and does not change the scientific failure disposition.

## Evidence
The PR retains exact runner/auditor source, plan/freeze, structured first outcome, raw counterexample timestamps, workflow run provenance, error check, artifact boundary and successor question. Raw v38/v39 logs remain at their existing canonical repository paths and are not duplicated.

No automatic claim of physical occupancy, useful control, v38-v39 causal difference or recovery-policy efficacy follows.
